raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer surfaced (and implicitly relied on) an auto-generated DuckDuckGo knowledge panel that listed Felix E. Feist’s birthplace as Los Angeles, which conflicts with more authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia, IMDb) that state New York City. The agent did not reconcile this discrepancy or prioritize reliable sources, and later repeated unproductive searches instead of following instructions to consult additional authoritative sites. This failure to resolve conflicting data could directly lead to the wrong birthplace being reported.
